verdicts.reason: A and B look the same. In both, the 'CLAYTONI' wordmark is pushed against the top edge and 'CREATIVE AGENCY' is stranded at the bottom, so the brand lockup is split apart. The two illustration clusters are shrunk to tiny thumbnails floating mid-canvas, and huge empty navy areas make up most of the frame. The original's characters, which carry the visual identity, are reduced to almost nothing, and the layout has no deliberate hierarchy or balance for the tall format.
